description: This file contains implementation of the HpackEntryCollector class used for testing HPACK header encoding/decoding in HTTP/2, including methods for handling header entries, validation, and string representation.

classes.name: HpackEntryCollector
classes.description: A class used for collecting and testing HPACK header entries in HTTP/2, with methods for handling header types, validation, and string conversion.

methods.name: HpackEntryCollector
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the collector.

methods.name: HpackEntryCollector
methods.description: Copy constructor.

methods.name: HpackEntryCollector
methods.description: Parameterized constructors for initializing with header type, index, and optional name/value Huffman encoding.

methods.name: ~HpackEntryCollector
methods.description: Destructor.

methods.name: OnIndexedHeader
methods.description: Handles an indexed header event.

methods.name: OnStartLiteralHeader
methods.description: Starts a literal header with specified type and optional name index.

methods.name: OnNameStart
methods.description: Begins processing header name string.

methods.name: OnNameData
methods.description: Processes header name string data.

methods.name: OnNameEnd
methods.description: Ends processing header name string.

methods.name: OnValueStart
methods.description: Begins processing header value string.

methods.name: OnValueData
methods.description: Processes header value string data.

methods.name: OnValueEnd
methods.description: Ends processing header value string.

methods.name: OnDynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Handles dynamic table size update event.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the collector to initial state.

methods.name: IsClear
methods.description: Checks if the collector is in a clear state.

methods.name: IsComplete
methods.description: Checks if the header entry collection is complete.

methods.name: LiteralNameExpected
methods.description: Determines if a literal name is expected based on header type.

methods.name: LiteralValueExpected
methods.description: Determines if a literal value is expected based on header type.

methods.name: ValidateIndexedHeader
methods.description: Validates an indexed header against expected index.

methods.name: ValidateLiteralValueHeader
methods.description: Validates a literal header with value.

methods.name: ValidateLiteralNameValueHeader
methods.description: Validates a literal header with name and value.

methods.name: ValidateDynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Validates dynamic table size update.

methods.name: AppendToHpackBlockBuilder
methods.description: Appends the header entry to an HPACK block builder.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the header entry.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the header entry with type and index.
